description: Photograph of a television screen showing a Fox News on-air graphic titled 'Redefining the word Patriot'. The graphic contrasts Google's listed synonyms for 'patriot' (nationalist, loyalist, isolationist, xenophobe) with the Merriam-Webster dictionary definition ('one who loves and supports his or her country'), implying Google is recasting the word negatively. Fox News logo and a 5:57 ET timestamp are visible, with a Venezuela news ticker along the bottom.
text: REDEFINING THE WORD 'PATRIOT'. GOOGLE'S 'PATRIOT' SYNONYMS: NATIONALIST, LOYALIST, ISOLATIONIST OR XENOPHOBE. MERRIAM-WEBSTER DICTIONARY 'PATRIOT' DEFINITION: 'ONE WHO LOVES AND SUPPORTS HIS OR HER COUNTRY.'. FOX NEWS. 5:57 ET. bm/FoxNews. VENEZUELA'S SOCIALIST GOVT BLAMES NATIONW
flags: The graphic's implied claim about Google's synonym listing is presented as the broadcast's claim, not verified

description: Screenshot of Q-drop text rendered on a light background, beginning with a link to a Sara Carter tweet. The drop poses rhetorical questions about auditing US officials and their families, alleges unexplained wealth of Maxine Waters, Nancy Pelosi, the Biden, Clinton and Obama families, suggests it is disguised under book deals, and closes with DRAIN THE SWAMP. Signed Q.
text: https://twitter.com/SaraCarterDC/status/1146175340433367040. Imagine what would happen, if, by law, every US Congressman/woman, US Senator, President etc. was by US law audited every 1-2 years by an independent agency. Imagine what would happen if those audits extended to all family members of such 'elected' official? Would D's continue to push for Foreign Aid to other C's vs. the Homeland? What happens when the kickbacks dry up? M. Waters $4mm House? N. Pelosi net worth $150mm+? J. Biden son/brother net worth tens of millions? Clinton family $200mm+ (pre election of BC less than $1mm)? Obama family $40mm+ (pre election less than $1mm)? Disguised under book deals? ............. Those who take are offered more powerful positions within the party (controlled). DRAIN THE SWAMP. Q
flags: Net-worth and corruption figures are the drop's unverified claims
People are named in the text, not pictured

description: Composite graphic: a photograph of Donald Trump on the right over a dark background, next to a screenshot of a tweet labelled 'Donald J. Trump Retweeted' from The Trump Train (@The_Trump_Train, Nov 28). The tweet contains a meme depicting Obama-era figures photoshopped behind jail bars — including Robert Mueller, John Podesta, Rod Rosenstein, Hillary Clinton, Huma Abedin, Barack Obama, Eric Holder, Bill Clinton and Loretta Lynch — under a caption claiming Russia collusion is a proven lie and asking when treason trials begin.
text: Donald J. Trump Retweeted. The Trump Train @The_Trump_Train · Nov 28. NOW THAT RUSSIA COLLUSION IS A PROVEN LIE, WHEN DO THE TRIALS FOR TREASON BEGIN?. 14K. 20K. 56K
flags: Meme's 'proven lie'/treason framing is an unverified claim

description: Screenshot of Q drop 940 (Mar 10 2018, tripcode !UW.yye1fxo, post 620670) whose attached image places two round antifa logos side by side: the red Antifaschistische Aktion emblem labelled '1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany' and the black/red Antifascist Action emblem labelled '2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America'. The drop text reads only 'Coincidence?' The image thus claims modern US antifa is the Democratic Party's paramilitary wing.
text: Mar 10 2018. 940. Mar 10 2018 20:29:12 Q !UW.yye1fxo 620670→. BC185452-3F1B-493B-98D9-92...png. 1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany. 2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America. ANTIFASCHISTISCHE AKTION. ANTIFASCIST ACTION. Coincidence? Q
